test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The average speed of a car is 1500 metres/minute. A sprinter covers 200 metres in 30 seconds. What is the difference in the speed of car and the speed of sprinter?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed of car in m/s = 1500 ÷ 60 = 25 m/s

Speed of sprinter in m/s = 200 ÷ 30 = 20/3 m/s

Difference in speed = 25 − 20/3 = (75 − 20) ÷ 3 = 55/3 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 55/3 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of car = 1500 metres/minute

Distance covered by sprinter = 200 metres

Time taken by sprinter = 30 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

1 minute = 60 seconds

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8d56f077e88100fe2ac528eaedd8eaa24b5b3745e5b87250a992497cabf3c8c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed of car = 1500 metres ÷ 60 seconds

⇒ Speed of car = 25 m/s

⇒ Speed of sprinter = 200 metres ÷ 30 seconds

⇒ Speed of sprinter = 20/3 m/s

⇒ Difference in speed = Speed of car − Speed of sprinter

⇒ Difference = 25 − 20/3

⇒ Difference = (75 − 20) ÷ 3

⇒ Difference = 55/3 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 55/3 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

When traveling equal distances at varying speeds S₁ and S₂, the formula applied is: Average Speed = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂).

Relative Speed

If two bodies move in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|. If they move in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂.
